EDITOR’S PICK / R&B

Yoon MiraeBreath (숨)

SINGLE / DECEMBER 2025

A single guitar leaves room for Yoon Mirae’s voice on “Breath.” Released in December 2025, this acoustic R&B song follows the small, ordinary reminders that remain after a breakup.
